cases.title: Kubernetes dockershim removal planning
cases.decision_prompt: A platform team operates Kubernetes clusters whose nodes rely on the in-tree dockershim integration. Choose the action that best protects the team's ability to adopt Kubernetes 1.24 while maintaining a supported container runtime.
cases.forecast_question: Using only information available at the cutoff, forecast the probability that "Migrate before Kubernetes 1.24" is the outcome-aligned action at the stated horizon.

options.label: Migrate before Kubernetes 1.24
options.description: Move nodes to a CRI-compatible runtime, or to a supported external Docker adapter, before adopting Kubernetes 1.24.

options.label: Retain the in-tree dockershim dependency
options.description: Defer runtime migration and plan to keep using the in-tree dockershim integration through Kubernetes 1.24.

sources.title: Kubernetes is Moving on From Dockershim: Commitments and Next Steps

cases.title: Prepare for optional no-GIL CPython
cases.decision_prompt: A CPython-dependent platform team must decide whether to reserve engineering capacity for free-threaded compatibility prototypes while PEP 703 is still a draft. Choose the action that best positions the platform if the proposal is accepted for CPython.
cases.forecast_question: Using only information available at the cutoff, forecast the probability that "Defer until formal acceptance" is the outcome-aligned action at the stated horizon.

options.label: Defer until formal acceptance
options.description: Do not reserve engineering capacity until the Steering Council formally accepts the proposal.

options.label: Prepare for acceptance
options.description: Reserve bounded engineering capacity now for compatibility testing and a free-threaded prototype.

sources.title: PEP 703 draft: Making the Global Interpreter Lock Optional in CPython

cases.title: Node.js 16 accelerated end-of-life response
cases.decision_prompt: A production service runs on Node.js 16 after the official release schedule moves its end-of-life date to September 2023. Choose the action that best preserves security support without depending on a later schedule extension.
cases.forecast_question: Using only information available at the cutoff, forecast the probability that "Upgrade before the revised end-of-life date" is the outcome-aligned action at the stated horizon.

options.label: Defer beyond the revised end-of-life date
options.description: Keep Node.js 16 in production beyond 2023-09-11 while expecting support or the schedule to be extended.

options.label: Upgrade before the revised end-of-life date
options.description: Move the service to a supported Node.js LTS line before 2023-09-11.

sources.title: Node.js release schedule with revised Node.js 16 end date

cases.title: Migrate away from standard-library distutils
cases.decision_prompt: A Python build tool imports distutils from the standard library. PEP 632 has been accepted and describes removal in Python 3.12. Choose the action that best preserves compatibility with that release.
cases.forecast_question: Using only information available at the cutoff, forecast the probability that "Retain the standard-library dependency" is the outcome-aligned action at the stated horizon.

options.label: Migrate before Python 3.12
options.description: Replace standard-library distutils imports with maintained packaging interfaces before adopting Python 3.12.

options.label: Retain the standard-library dependency
options.description: Keep importing standard-library distutils and defer migration until after Python 3.12 ships.
